notes: Farizon Auto (a Geely-group commercial vehicle brand) has launched electric vans in Australia: the SV van range (multiple body/roof/wheelbase configurations) and the V7E van. No confirmed AUD pricing could be found for the SV range from any source, so priceAud is null for those variants. The V7E has a reported drive-away price range of approx. $49,990-$53,990 depending on configuration; the lower figure is used as the base/entry price with the range noted in priceBasis. The Farizon H9E was identified in sourcing as a 'Light Truck' model; its GVM could not be confirmed against the 4.5-tonne inclusion threshold used in this dataset, so it has been excluded pending verification rather than guessed into or out of scope.
